---
title: "Trends"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
attacks <- read_rds("data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  filter(Fatal_clean != "Unknown", !is.na(Activity)) |>
  count(Activity, Fatal_clean) |>
  group_by(Activity) |>
  mutate(activity_total = sum(n)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(activity_total >= 50) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = fct_reorder(Activity, activity_total),
    y = n,
    fill = Fatal_clean
  )) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Fatal vs Non-fatal Shark Attacks by Activity",
    x = "Activity",
    y = "Number of attacks",
    fill = "Outcome"
  )
```
